pages.text: The $(bold)Dryer$() is the powered version of the Drying Rack. It dries items faster using RF energy.$(br)$(br)$(bold)What it dries:$()$(br)• $(bold)Any Strain Bud$() → Dried Bud of that strain$(br)• $(bold)Tobacco Leaves$() → Dried Tobacco Leaves$(br)$(br)$(bold)Why dry buds?$() Dried buds give stronger effects when consumed. They can then be ground in the Grinder or Manual Grinder to produce weed.$(br)$(br)The Dryer is crafted using the $(bold)Drying Rack$() as a component — craft the Drying Rack first (no Hemp Core needed), then upgrade to this powered version.
